verdict.rationale: pnpm's first-class monorepo support lets you run tasks across many workspace projects at once, filtered to the ones you touched. Catalogs let a single line in pnpm-workspace.yaml upgrade a dependency version everywhere, and `pnpm audit --fix` adds overrides for all vulnerable dependencies in one step. Community users report that the built-in multi-package workflow works well across large monorepos. Missing for 10: detailed docs on recursive/multi-package command semantics (e.g. `-r`, filter syntax, parallelism), and hands-on corroboration of bulk operations in agent-driven or automated workflows.
